en.description: Wenzhang Du is an independent researcher interested in data mining, retrieval-augmented generation, and trustworthy machine learning.
en.role: Data mining, RAG & trustworthy machine learning
heroStatement: AI advances faster than our ability to measure, verify, and understand it.
I work to close those gaps.
en.heroIntro: I’m interested in how systems find and use information, and in how we can assess the reliability of their behavior.
en.degree: B.Eng. in Computer Engineering and Artificial Intelligence
en.aboutLead: My research starts with a simple question: how do we know an AI system is behaving reliably?
aboutParagraphs: I hold a B.Eng. in Computer Engineering and Artificial Intelligence. My research background includes model auditing, language model safety, efficient deep learning, computer vision, and remote sensing.

research.title: Data mining & RAG
research.description: I’m interested in discovering useful patterns in data, finding relevant information, and using retrieved evidence to support generation.

research.title: Trustworthy machine learning
research.description: I’m interested in how to test model behavior, whether results hold across conditions, and how to quantify uncertainty in evaluations.

recentResearch: Since my WSDM work on evidence selection, I’ve used matched comparisons to understand which decisions explain changes in scores. I separate choices that usually change together and trace changes in individual examples that aggregate scores can hide.

In retrieval, I test the effect of document layout while keeping facts and relevance fixed. In RAG, I separate the effects of evidence budget, subset search, and passage order. In factuality audits, I compare how claim pairing affects precision at the same verification budget. In reasoning evaluations, I check what the examples actually require before interpreting the model scores.
en.publicationIntro: Conference papers and preprints on trustworthy learning, evaluation, and applied AI.

zh.role: 数据挖掘、检索增强生成与可信机器学习
zh.heroEyebrow: 独立研究者 · 个人学术主页
heroStatement: AI 的发展速度，超越了我们衡量、验证与理解它的能力。

zh.heroIntro: 我对系统如何发现和利用信息感兴趣，也关心怎样评估模型行为的可靠性。
zh.degree: 计算机工程与人工智能学士学位
zh.aboutLead: 我的研究始于一个朴素的问题：我们如何知道一个人工智能系统的行为是可靠的？
aboutParagraphs: 我拥有计算机工程与人工智能学士学位。此前的研究涉及模型审计、大语言模型安全、高效深度学习、计算机视觉和遥感。

research.title: 数据挖掘与 RAG
research.description: 我对怎样从数据中发现有用的模式，以及怎样用检索到的证据辅助生成感兴趣。

research.title: 可信机器学习
research.description: 我也关心怎样检验模型行为、判断评估结论在不同条件下是否成立，并衡量其中的不确定性。

recentResearch: 从 WSDM 的证据选择研究到最近几项工作，我一直关心分数变化究竟来自哪一步。我用配对比较拆开通常一起变化的因素，再回到逐例结果，查看哪些差异被总体分数掩盖。
在检索研究中，我固定事实和相关性标签，比较不同文档布局的影响。在 RAG 中，我区分证据预算、组合搜索和段落顺序各自的作用。在事实性审计中，我固定核验预算，比较事实陈述的配对方式如何影响估计精度。在推理评估中，我先检查样例实际要求什么，再解读模型分数。
